lane: standard 11x11 weak-resolution, S2{59,60} class2 long-term lane (verification side)
title: Independent crosscheck of the published head-1476 parent census and class-2 candidate cover
method: Third independent implementation: row-side D4 join via the six 5-stone subset canonical forms of each S6 row (the published records join from the parent side with 8 images); minimum-cover count by a 2^11 counting DP and independently by brute-force enumeration of all perfect matchings (11 x 945); the full published 757-root table, ranking, per-parent baselines for all 174 parents, and the lexicographic minimum cover are compared field by field.

derived.published_mjs_rerun_note: The published mjs (git blob da068262) was run twice cold on a reconstructed checkout of the pinned inputs in this same session: both runs byte-identical, 735/735 checks all PASS, and all headline aggregates agree with the published JSON; the published JSON itself was produced by the earlier 745-check version and is not byte-reproducible from the published mjs (different JSON schema and check naming).

findings.severity: counting-labeling error in the published record (planning unaffected)
findings.summary: The published head-1476 census claims 337,020 minimum 6-root covers (all_minimum_cover_sets), but that number counts only the disjoint partition-shaped covers (5 disjoint pair roots + 1 singleton root). Minimum covers of the overlapping shape (6 pair roots with exactly one doubly-covered row) also exist and were missed: 22,590 of them. The total number of minimum 6-root covers is 359,610.
findings.evidence: 2^11 counting DP over the 757 pinned roots: 359,610 covers of size 6; independent brute-force decomposition: 337,020 partition covers (published number) + 22,590 overlapping covers; three-way agreement. Concrete counterexample cover (row 00000000000000403800000008000008 doubly covered): 00000000000000403800000008000028, 00000000000000403800000008004008, 00000000000000403800000408200000, 00000000000000c09002000200001000, 00000000010000809003000000000001, 00000000020001003810000008000000.
findings.impact: The minimum cover size (6), the lower bound, the lexicographically first cover, and every planning decision are unaffected: all minimum covers still use exactly 6 roots. The published mjs check named 'candidate.minimum_cover_count' (and the original 745-check run) label the partition count as the total minimum-cover count.

findings.summary: The published mjs (git blob da068262) re-derives and confirms every headline aggregate of the published JSON when run on the pinned inputs (735/735 checks all PASS, double run byte-identical, including 806/757/708+49/6/337,020/5,250), but it does not byte-reproduce the published JSON: the published JSON was produced by the earlier 745-check version with a different JSON schema and check naming. The log's '745/745 checks' refers to that unpublished version.
findings.impact: No substantive disagreement between the published JSON and the published mjs was found.

interpretation_guard: Verification-side crosscheck of published records only. No 7-stone engine search was run, no new WIN7-D10 or REFUTED-D10 verdict was produced, no receipt was folded, and no S5 parent was closed. The six-root cover is a geometric candidate plan conditional on future WIN7-D10 certificates. REFUTED-D10 and STERILE are not LOSS proofs.
